summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing an at-the-market sales agreement with Roth Capital Partners and H.C. Wainwright. Under the agreement, the company may sell up to $100,000,000 of its Class A common stock from time to time through the agents, with commissions up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. The company will reimburse agent counsel fees up to $75,000 initially and $7,500 per quarter thereafter. Proceeds are intended for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation.
